measurement_protocol.jit_ms: synchronized first-call wall time; measured upper bound including one execution and any JIT/autotune
measurement_protocol.latency: median CUDA-event time over synchronized post-first-call repetitions
measurement_protocol.scratch_bytes: peak CUDA allocator bytes above immutable payload/input baseline, including route output and explicit working buffers
measurement_protocol.startup_ms: synchronized route preparation and explicit-buffer allocation

payload_provenance.statement: Random EXL3 payloads qualify route structure, parity, latency, and memory only; they do not represent checkpoint values or model fidelity.
